# An importer descriptor file getter has retained callers despite its current unimplemented result

1355 removes the descriptor’s initialized file member and changes GetFile to return NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. At the accepted endpoint the concrete descriptor GetFile returns NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, while CreateNewMailboxDescriptor still constructs that class and Apple Mail discovery still calls GetFile before adding descriptors. One account branch continues on failure; another returns it. Preserve this concrete source mismatch as an investigation limit, not a style rule or proven end-user import failure. Importer availability and execution were not verified. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/import/src.
